body.name: M_k
body.type: ordered maximal ancestral graph family map
body.def: \(M_0(\eta)\) is the observational latent projection on \(U_0=V\) associated with \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\). For \(k\in[K]\), \(M_k(\eta)\) is the latent projection on \(U_k=V\cup\{\zeta_k\}\) of the interventional twin graph whose observed law is the pooled selected law \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\).
